I am a data scientist with over 10 years of experience working with data in health (SRH), HIV, agriculture, livelihoods, and nutrition. Currently finishing my MSc in Data Science for Health and Social Care at the University of Edinburgh.

My work focuses on statistical modelling, machine learning, data visualization, and building reproducible data pipelines. I lead the [RUsers Malawi](https://www.meetup.com/r-users-malawi/) community in Lilongwe.

## Education & Experience
- [MSc in Data Science for Health and Social care](https://mgphs.ed.ac.uk/msc-data-science-for-health-and-social-care) | [**University of Edinburgh**](https://www.ed.ac.uk/)| 2023- present
- Diploma in Monitoring and Evaluation | [The Catholic University of Malawi](https://cunima1.online/) | 2018-20
- BSc Agricultural Economics | [University of Malawi](https://www.luanar.ac.mw/luanar/) | 2011-15

## Current role

Monitoring, Evaluation and Data Use Specialist at [Family Planning Association of Malawi](https://www.fpamalawi.org/).
